steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; document.getElementById('hud').hidden=true; g.bears.directorT=9999; const we=g.env.weather; we.cloud=0.25; we.cloudTarget=0.25; we.rain=0; we.rainTarget=0; we.timer=9999; __rhf.god(true); g.env.timeScale=0; g.wildlife.threatPos=()=>({x:1e7,z:1e7,loud:0}); const W=g.world; window.__hands=()=>{ g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); }; window.__face=async(id,tx,tz,time,pitch)=>{ const p=W.place(id); g.env.setTime(time); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,Math.atan2(-(tx-p.x),-(tz-p.z))); g.player.pitch=pitch; __hands(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); g.env.setTime(time); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000)); return id+' facing '+Math.round(Math.hypot(tx-p.x,tz-p.z))+' m'; }; window.__best=(near,rad,score)=>{let best=null; for(let dz=-rad;dz<=rad;dz+=6) for(let dx=-rad;dx<=rad;dx+=6){ const x=near.x+dx, z=near.z+dz; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,30)) continue; const s=score(x,z); if(s>-1e8&&(!best||s>best.s)) best={x,z,s}; } return best; }; window.__wade=(tx,tz,dist,maxd)=>{ let best=null; for(let k=0;k<64;k++){ const a=k/64*6.283; for(const dd of [dist,dist*1.3,dist*1.7,dist*2.2]){ const x=tx+Math.cos(a)*dd, z=tz+Math.sin(a)*dd; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,10)) continue; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(w&&w.depth>maxd) continue; if(g.colliders.circlesNear(x,z,2).some(c=>Math.hypot(c.x-x,c.z-z)<c.r+0.8)) continue; const sc=dd*0.1+(w?w.depth:0); if(!best||sc<best.sc) best={x,z,sc}; } } return best; }; window.__look=async(tx,tz,ty,x,z,hour)=>{ g.env.setTime(hour); g.player.place(x,z,Math.atan2(-(tx-x),-(tz-z))); g.player.pitch=Math.atan2(ty-(g.player.pos.y+1.7),Math.hypot(tx-x,tz-z)); __hands(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); g.env.setTime(hour); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000)); return 'ok'; }; return 'ready'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const flowers=(x,z)=>{ let s=0; for(let j=-2;j<=2;j++) for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++){ s+=W.flower[W.cellIndex(x+i*3,z+j*3)]; } const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(w&&w.depth>0) return -1e9; return s/25-W.slopeAt(x,z)*300; }; const b=__best(W.place('landing'),420,flowers); const s=__wade(b.x,b.z,7,0); if(!s) return 'no meadow spot'; await __look(b.x,b.z,W.heightAt(b.x,b.z)+0.6,s.x,s.z,11); return 'meadow'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const F=g.floaters; const L=W.lakes.find(l=>l.tint!=='glacial'); const m=F.padMesh; const mm=new (m.matrix.constructor)(); const q=new (m.matrix.constructor)(); let best=null; for(let i=0;i<m.count;i+=5){ m.getMatrixAt(i,mm); const x=mm.elements[12], z=mm.elements[14]; let n=0; for(let j=Math.max(0,i-40);j<Math.min(m.count,i+40);j++){ m.getMatrixAt(j,q); if(Math.hypot(q.elements[12]-x,q.elements[14]-z)<4) n++; } if(!best||n>best.n) best={x,z,n}; } const az=(40+12.5*(280/17))*Math.PI/180, sx=Math.sin(az), sz=-Math.cos(az); let spot=null; for(let k=0;k<32;k++){ const a=k/32*6.283; const x=best.x+Math.cos(a)*4.5, z=best.z+Math.sin(a)*4.5; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(!w||w.depth>=0.9) continue; const facing=(-Math.cos(a))*sx+(-Math.sin(a))*sz; if(!spot||facing<spot.facing) spot={x,z,facing}; } if(!spot) return 'no wading spot'; await __look(best.x,best.z,L.level,spot.x,spot.z,17.5); return 'lilies, '+best.n+' pads within 4 m, sun behind '+(-spot.facing).toFixed(2)})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const F=g.floaters; const p=W.place('bend'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,0); const saved=g.focus; g.focus={x:p.x,y:0,z:p.z}; let pick=null, fills=0; for(; fills<12&&!pick; fills++){ F.locateRiver(p.x,p.z); F.filled=false; for(let i=0;i<80;i++) F.update(0.05); for(const d of F.drifters){ if(!d.alive||d.K.name!=='drift-log') continue; const s=__wade(d.x,d.z,4,fills<6?0.45:0.8); if(s&&(!pick||Math.hypot(d.x-s.x,d.z-s.z)<pick.dd)) pick={d,s,dd:Math.hypot(d.x-s.x,d.z-s.z)}; } } g.focus=saved; if(!pick) return 'no log near a shore after '+fills+' fills'; F.__upd=F.update; F.update=()=>{}; await __look(pick.d.x,pick.d.z,pick.d.level,pick.s.x,pick.s.z,12); return 'driftwood at '+pick.dd.toFixed(1)+' m after '+fills+' fills'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; if(g.floaters.__upd) g.floaters.update=g.floaters.__upd; const W=g.world; const cs=g.scenery.cascades; if(!cs.length) return 'no cascades'; let best=null; for(const c of cs){ const m=c.path[Math.floor(c.path.length/2)]; for(let k=0;k<36;k++){ const a=k/36*6.283; for(const d of [180,240,300,360]){ const x=m[0]+Math.cos(a)*d, z=m[2]+Math.sin(a)*d; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,10)||W.waterAt(x,z)) continue; const h=W.heightAt(x,z); if(h>m[1]-10) continue; let clear=true; for(let i=1;i<30;i++){ const q=i/30; const px=x+(m[0]-x)*q, pz=z+(m[2]-z)*q; if(W.heightAt(px,pz)>h+1.7+(m[1]+3-(h+1.7))*q) {clear=false;break;} } if(!clear) continue; const sc=c.drop-d*0.1; if(!best||sc>best.sc) best={c,m,x,z,h,d,sc}; } } } if(!best) return 'no clear view of a cascade'; const {c,m,x,z,h,d}=best; await __look(m[0],m[2],m[1],x,z,14); return 'cascade dropping '+Math.round(c.drop)+' m from '+d+' m'})()
